svg.title: hypot reads a word it did not update
svg.desc: Lines 81 to 84 multiply a and b by 2^1022 and leave ha and hb as they were; lines 85 to 90, the 2^600 scaling, write the words back; line 97 reads ha, which on the 2^1022 path is the word of the unscaled a.
